title: tldraw × ComfyUI: Four Experiments
blurb: tldraw as a scriptable infinite canvas, driven by a local Hermes Agent over its HTTP API with ComfyUI generating alongside — cat-counting grids, hand-drawn perspective studies, stars turned into portals via img2img, and a four-LoRA style wedge.

thumb.alt: Cats counting up one to nine, stars becoming cosmic portals, and four LoRA styles of the same kitchen cat
